faqs.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS – SMP CORRECTION (SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION REPAIR)

list.q: Can a bad SMP always be fixed with correction?
list.a: Not always – but most poorly done SMP treatments can be significantly improved. Free and honest SMP correction assessments are available.

list.q: Do I need to remove the old SMP pigment with a laser first?
list.a: In some cases, yes. In others, correction can begin immediately without laser removal.

list.q: How soon can I schedule an SMP correction?
list.a: If your bad SMP is older than a few weeks, correction can often start right away. Fresh SMP should be evaluated after stabilization.

list.q: Can I get a new hairline with SMP correction?
list.a: Yes – if your scalp condition and pigment placement allow it.
